advice: Переслушайте отмеченные ноты перед следующей попыткой.
Для повторной проверки сделайте запись без фонового звука.

alignment.method: Pitch subsequence edit alignment + robust global affine time fit; no local warping

scoring_rule: 100 × (1 − affected note events / (reference notes + extra notes)). A substitution counts once; a simultaneous timing difference is not counted twice. Only complete confidently aligned measures are scored. Uncertain detections lower the provisional agreement, not the confirmed error count; the interval treats all uncertain detections as errors / none as errors.
